name: MetaboNet Consolidated T1D Dataset
license: Mixed: public subset plus DUA-governed sources; check each component dataset
description: Consolidated T1D management resource combining datasets with overlapping CGM and insulin pump dosing records into a standardized format.
recommended_use: Best long-term target for broad external validation once local access and terms are documented.
recommended_prep_command: Use MetaboNet's provided conversion pipeline, then map the exported time-series columns into IINTS with iints import-data or iints research blend-datasets.
limitations: Not all components are unrestricted; keep source dataset lineage and access terms in model cards.
Do not treat a consolidated benchmark as independent evidence if its source datasets overlap with training data.

name: Glucose-ML Dataset Collection
license: Collection of third-party datasets; license and access depend on each linked dataset
description: Benchmark-oriented collection of longitudinal diabetes datasets intended to guide robust AI development and short-term glucose prediction comparisons.
recommended_use: Use as a research map to choose external datasets and benchmark protocols; do not treat it as one homogeneous training set.
recommended_prep_command: Use iints data research-plan to select concrete source datasets, then prepare each dataset separately before iints research blend-datasets.
limitations: It is a collection/reference, not a single standardized raw data file.
Each component dataset needs separate provenance, license, and leakage checks.
